調べたわけでもないのに、たまたま辿りついて、雰囲気に一気にもってかれました。 とにかく全てがオシャレです。 オシャレなだけではなく、ちょっとすごいコーヒーも美味しかったです。

郡上八幡に流れる川に降りようと思った際に水出しコーヒーの文字が目に入り、つい買ってしまいました。素敵なロケーションなのに、お店の前の夏の空と川、山を背景に撮影するのを忘れて後悔…笑 フェアトレード、オーガニックのコーヒーだそうです。美味しいお水と豆でかつ、水出しだからか苦味がなくスッキリと飲みやすかったです。真夏の郡上八幡歩きにぴったりでした。インスタグラムフォローで郡上おどりのステッカーも貰っちゃいました！

3136.edj: このリゾートは、高品質な地元の食材を使ったユニークなショップが豊富で、美味しい食事やスイーツが楽しめると評判です。また、清潔でリラックスできる施設も特徴のようです。 一方で、食事は値段が高く、量が少ないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Google seems to think that this is a hotel. There's a hotel on top of this shopping centre called hotel Vision, but this itself is just a shopping area. That being said, it's a mix between tourist attraction and regular shopping centre. The layout is unique with two main sides plus the hotel. One side is unified under a giant sail-like building, while the other is across a bridge and is scattered like a little…

Sebastian Street in VISON is a must-visit for anyone who loves to snack and stroll. The air is filled with the smell of freshly baked bread, and it’s hard to resist the colorful sweets, creamy gelato, and tasty bites made with local ingredients. Lined with charming little shops, it’s the perfect place to wander, nibble, and soak in the lively atmosphere — just make sure you go hungry!

I’ve always wanted to go and finally was able to. I went on a road trip with one of my friend and we decided to stay here. This was a road trip and since my car is a camper van we decided to reserve the campsite and not the hotel. Therefore I have no idea what the hotel experiences but the campsite experience was very fun. The toilet outside was very clean and the lights do turn off when there aren’t people around…

3137.a: Goshikinuma Ponds, Kengamine Hibara, Kitashiobara, Yama District, Fukushima 966-0501, Japan
3137.aj: 〒966-0501 福島県耶麻郡北塩原村檜原剣ケ峯 五色沼湖沼群
catj: ハイキング コース
3137.ed: Picturesque attraction featuring a series of volcano-formed lakes known for their changing colors.
3137.edj: 度重なる火山の噴火によってつくられた美しい湖沼群。その時々で色が変化して見えることで知られる。

rv.t: We walked the entire Goshikinuma Nature Trail, and the lakes are absolutely beautiful. They truly display a unique variety of colors depending on the angle you look at them. While we didn't spot any red hues, the vibrant blues were incredibly striking and unique. If you are coming by car, it is best to park at the East entrance. Start by visiting the tourist information center here. They provide wonderful, detailed…

Easy, beautiful and calming trail with astounding ponds. The most fluorescent water I’ve ever witnessed. There’s a small rowing boat rental on the east side of the trail for only 1000 yen for 30 minutes that I would highly recommend taking out.

Easy and pleasant walk! Came here with my parents and the trail was very manageable. The path around the pond takes about an hour at a relaxed pace, with beautiful views and fresh air. Great spot for families and older visitors.

3138.a: Ouchi-juku, Ouchi, Shimogo, Minamiaizu District, Fukushima 969-5207, Japan
3138.aj: 〒969-5207 福島県南会津郡下郷町大内大内宿
3138.ed: Preserved post town featuring thatched-roof Edo-period buildings along its main street.
3138.edj: 茅葺屋根の民家が街道沿いに立ち並ぶ、江戸時代の宿場町の保存地区。

rv.t: Ōuchijuku feels like traveling back in time to the Edo period ❄️🏮 This historic post town in Fukushima is famous for its traditional thatched-roof houses lined along the old street, creating a nostalgic and peaceful atmosphere unlike anywhere else in Japan. I visited during winter, and the snow-covered scenery made the village look even more magical. Walking through the streets while snow gently covered the rooftops…

This is a wonderful tourist attraction located just outside the city. The view is beautiful, and the entire village was covered in snow during my visit, making it look absolutely stunning. One of the best things about this place is that it wasn’t nearly as crowded as I expected, which made it very peaceful and easy to take plenty of photos without other people in the background. If you are looking for a scenic spot…

Ouchi-juku felt like stepping back in time. The preserved thatched-roof houses, peaceful atmosphere, and traditional streets made our visit truly memorable. Walking through the village at a relaxed pace, browsing local shops, and enjoying the beautiful mountain scenery made it a wonderful experience. It was a charming place that perfectly captured the nostalgic beauty of rural Japan.

3139.a: Tsunoshima Bridge, Hohokucho Oaza Kanda, Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi 759-5331, Japan
3139.aj: 〒759-5331 山口県下関市豊北町大字神田角島大橋
3139.ed: People say this tourist destination offers breathtaking views of the emerald green and cobalt blue ocean, with a long, beautiful bridge that creates a stunning contrast. Visitors highlight the exhilarating feeling of driving across the bridge, making it a popular spot for scenic drives. They also appreciate the free parking and well-maintained restrooms.
3139.edj: クチコミによると、この観光地はエメラルドグリーンとコバルトブルーの海が息をのむほど美しく、長く美しい橋が素晴らしいコントラストを生み出していると評判です。橋を車で渡る際の爽快感が特に高く評価されており、景色の良いドライブコースとして人気を集めています。無料駐車場と手入れの行き届いたトイレも利用者に喜ばれています。

rv.t: The view of the bridge is stunning. Unfortunately, the weather wasn’t great when we were taking photos, so we couldn’t capture how the sunlight reflects off the sea and enhances the beauty of the bridge. Luckily, it turned sunny while we were crossing, and we managed to take a few great shots.

This spot has been featured in the book “Places to Visit Before You Die: World’s Most Spectacular Views,” so it was somewhere I had been curious about for a long time and finally decided to visit. The photos shown in the book were very impressive and made me want to see the scenery in person. However, on the day I visited, the sky was cloudy, and the view felt quite different from what I had seen in the photos. The…

✨ Tsunoshima Bridge (角島大橋) ✨ 🚗 Free to visit (walk or drive any time) A beautiful bridge with amazing ocean views. Worth visiting to enjoy the scenery, take photos, and experience one of Japan’s best coastal drives.😍

3140.a: Jiyū Gakuen Myōnichikan, 2 Chome-31-3 Nishiikebukuro, Toshima City, Tokyo 171-0021, Japan
3140.aj: 〒171-0021 東京都豊島区西池袋２丁目３１−３ 自由学園明日館
catj: ヘリテージビルディング
3140.ed: Wedding & concert venue built in 1921 as a school by architects Frank Lloyd Wright & Arata Endo.
3140.edj: 1921 年に建築家のフランク ロイド ライトと遠藤新が学校として建てた、結婚式場＆コンサート会場。

rv.t: Wanted to visit unique architectural site by Frank Loyd Wright. So glad that I get to visit and joined the tour to learn the incredible history of this humble building.

Had high hopes to see Frank Lloyd Wright’s Tokyo building, since I’ve only experienced the Guggenheim in New York and some of his houses in Chicago. Unfortunately, it was closed for a private event when I visited. At least I could walk around and admire the beautiful exterior, but I’ll need to come back another time to see the inside.
An important historical and architectural monument located in the city centre

3140.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

3141.aj: 〒390-0222 長野県松本市入山辺 美ヶ原
3141.ed: Peaceful highlands with rolling hills, pasture land & an eclectic collection of outdoor art.
3141.edj: バラエティに富む芸術作品の数々が屋外に展示されている静かな高原。ゆるやかな丘陵、牧草地が広がる。

rv.t: So relaxing, beautiful mountain peak with nature filled with fresh air. So many trails to explore. Especially if you love sunrise that's a great place for this. With hotels and inn this place is amazing for holidays. I enjoyed the hiking very much.

Beautifull view in matsumoto city. When you come to this city,dont forget to visit this mountain. Around 1.5 hours from downtown. Here you can view the nature,blue sky,green of grass,and also the cows. You can also see the city beneath you. Becarefull with the wind,sometimes become very strong. And if you are the biker, you can visit this place with beautifull view during bikes.

The parking is little bit down so to reach here you have to walk for about 45 minutes and sooner as per your pace. It is a beautiful highland where there is cow farm. Better to take some jacket as it might get cold at evening and night although it was summer. Take some snacks and water just in case you are hungry and thirsty. There is nothing just nature and you🙏🏻🙏🏻

3142.a: Qibao Malatang, 2 Chome-2-9 Fujimi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 102-0071, Japan
3142.aj: 〒102-0071 東京都千代田区富士見２丁目２−９ 七宝麻辣湯 飯田橋店
3142.edj: テーブル席も備える白を基調とした内装の店内で、具材や辛さが選べるスープ春雨や薬膳火鍋を提供。担々麵やご飯メニューもある。

rv.t: Spicy vermicelli soup! Upon entering the restaurant, you get to choose in a shelf a variety of meat and vegetable ingredients to add on as toppings to your soup. Up to 3 ingredients are free. After that, it’s ¥150 per topping. You can choose the spiciness level. From 1-3 is free. 4 and up is an additional charge. Level 3 spiciness is still bearable but that depends on you though. The flavor of the soup is the…

This place has become my regular lunch canteen because the spicy soup is so hearty! Customers can choose spice level from 0 to 5 and select their own toppings and noodles. They also have Dan Dan noodles, pork over rice in Taiwanese style and dessert:)

Chinese style ramen, instead of regular noodles they use (you can order regular kinds for an extra charge). Upon entering, you chose three toppings, there are a variety of vegetables, seafood, meat, and wonton. There is an extra cost for more than 3 toppings. Spices range from 1-5, 4 and 5 cost an extra charge for around 100yen. And anything above a 6 is plus 60yen if my memory serves correctly. Excellent spicy…

3143.a: Sansho Kofuku (Sānshāng Qiǎofú) - Akasaka, 3 Chome-12-11 Akasaka, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0052, Japan
3143.aj: 〒107-0052 東京都港区赤坂３丁目１２−１１ 三商巧福 赤坂店
3143.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic Taiwanese beef noodle soup, braised pork rice, and a variety of side dishes, including delicious tapioca and grass jelly milk tea. They also highlight the friendly staff and the convenient option to order half-size noodle portions. Some reviews mention the portions can be small.
3143.edj: クチコミによると、このレストランの本格的な台湾牛肉麺、魯肉飯、そしておいしいタピオカや仙草ミルクティーを含む様々なサイドメニューが人気です。また、親しみやすいスタッフと、麺をハーフサイズで注文できる便利な点も評価されています。 一部のクチコミでは、料理の量が少ないという意見もあります。

rv.t: Staff was friendly and food was delicious. It was my first time trying Taiwanese food (never been to Taiwan) and I didn't regret it. Yummy! Free ice water on the table.
The beef noodle is exactly like those you will have in Taiwan. While they don't sell braised pork rice at the chain stores in Taiwan, it is still very good. These are the taste of home!

The flavor is really delicious. Compared to the rich, fatty aroma of ramen, Taiwanese beef noodle soup focuses more on a blend of seasoning and slow-braised beef. It’s not overly greasy, making it especially satisfying when you’re feeling really hungry. A comforting bowl of beef noodles—I’d give it four stars.

3143.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3144.a: Ofuro-cafe Hakuju, 337-1 Wataruse, Kamikawa, Kodama District, Saitama 367-0301, Japan
3144.aj: 〒367-0301 埼玉県児玉郡神川町渡瀬３３７−１ 温泉と発酵 おふろcafé 白寿の湯
3144.ed: Stylish retreat with a natural spa & hot-spring baths, plus a restaurant, library & treatment room.
3144.edj: 天然温泉とレストラン、ライブラリー、トリートメント ルームがあるスタイリッシュな保養施設。

rv.t: A great place to relax. They have a restaurant, several rest areas, mangas to read, massage chairs and free refillable black coffee. But take note that it can get crowded depending on the day and time. The first floor appears to be newly renovated. The onsen is found on the 2nd floor. It is a bit old compared to the other facilities but it was still very relaxing. I enjoyed that the water was a bit deep. Enjoyed the…

Great place. Popular place. Very relaxing, aesthetic resting area. Many books, mangas, and massage chairs. Two baths in female onsen, one indoor and one outdoor. The onsen made my skin felt smooth. They also have free mud mask provided. We only did 90 minutes but would love to go back for a longer stay.
Very relaxing small onsen! The food was also excellent! Yumm! You can try clay mask inside the onsen - though it made the water a bit muddy as people went inside the bath with the clay mask on.

3145.a: Tenzan Onsen, １階 208 Yumotochaya, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0312, Japan
3145.aj: 〒250-0312 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町湯本茶屋２０８ １階 天山湯治郷
3145.ed: Traditional Japanese baths with a range of pools & a waterfall in serene quarters.
3145.edj: 閑静な場所にある伝統的な日本の温泉。複数の風呂と滝がある。

rv.t: The best onsen I’ve been to in Hakone. It’s welcoming, friendly and most of all okay for people with tattoos, we had no issue getting in. However keep in mind, I only had 4-5 palm sized ones and she had two smaller ones (not sure about people more covered with tattoos though!). The inside had great facilities and was super comfortable. We had a great time visiting, for just 1350 yen (with free pass discount of 100…

Delightful experience — absolutely recommended. The atmosphere was quiet, relaxing, and especially perfect after 7pm or on a rainy day. Great value for money. Not overly crowded. A few things to know before visiting: * You need a small towel for the onsen area (not a regular towel but like 20-30cm one), or you’ll have to buy one * Payment is outside through a ticket machine and cash only. * After entering, you go to…

I had an amazing experience. It was very easy to get a ticket. Just use the vending machines at the bottom of the entrance. Bring a small towel or buy one for 200 Yen (nice souvenir). And then enjoy about 7 different outdoor baths and an old school steam room (with fresh tea leaves). Staff was super friendly and even ensured that I had transport afterwards. The night sky from the baths was stunning. It was perfect!

3146.a: Toshimaen Niwa-no-yu, 3 Chome-25-1 Koyama, Nerima City, Tokyo 176-8531, Japan
3146.aj: 〒176-8531 東京都練馬区向山３丁目２５−１ 豊島園 庭の湯
3146.ed: This relaxed co-ed bathhouse offers indoor & outdoor pools, along with saunas & massage chairs.
3146.edj: 男女混合エリアもあるリラックスできる雰囲気の温泉施設。内風呂、露天風呂、サウナ、マッサージ チェアを完備。

rv.t: First Onsen for my trips here in Tokyo. Right after The Making of Harry Potter touring, just 300 m away apart 🤩. A lot of Japanese signs and a little English signs but not too hard to understand. The staffs try to encourage and comfort me as combination of native and english languages. 😎 Thank you for assisting me 🙏.

I'm really concerned about something that happened here. The onsen is great, everything is well organized and there's a garden with the mixed pools and relaxing areas to lay down.. even a small waterfall.. this is where I was laying down alone in an area with four mattresses next to the waterfall. Then a guy and a girl arrived. The girl didn't seemed comfortable. The guy seemed consistently older (although also…

This was an amazing place to relax. Everything you do here helps you to decompress and escape. As an American who speaks only a little Japanese, here are some tips for navigating the facility. 1. Remove shoes and place in a locker. Put a one hundred yen coin in the slot to remove the key. (You'll get it back when you reclaim your shoes. 2. Proceed to the counter and give them your key. Pay for your admission. You…

3147.a: Japan, 〒250-0408 Kanagawa, Ashigarashimo District, Hakone, Gora, 1320-261 COFFEE CAMP
3147.aj: 〒250-0408 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町強羅１３２０−２６１ COFFEE CAMP
3147.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including lattes and Americanos, along with tasty food options like egg toast, hot dogs, and spicy chicken curry. They also highlight the welcoming atmosphere, good music, and friendly, English-speaking staff. Guests mention the reasonable prices and convenient location near Gora Station.
3147.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、ラテやアメリカーノなどの美味しいコーヒーと、エッグトースト、ホットドッグ、スパイシーチキンカレーといった美味しいフードメニューを評価しています。また、居心地の良い雰囲気、センスの良い音楽、親しみやすい英語を話すスタッフも高く評価されています。強羅駅近くの便利な立地で、価格も手頃というクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: This is the closest restaurant to our hotel in Gora. We would often pass by it and it would always seem to be packed with people. The first time we passed here, we just got coffee to go, so the second time we visited, we made sure to try some food. I personally tried their pork ribs set and tiramisu. Both were really good. They also were kind enough to accommodate us even if we were a big group of 14. We were just…

Came here both mornings during our stay in Gora and it's such a nice little gem. It does fill up quite quickly so getting there early is definitely a good idea. The menu is fairly simple overall with typical Cafe fare. I usually don't drink coffee though but the Latte was delightful, along with the little toast sandwiches (I had the roast beef toast which was pretty good) Now I have to point out the real star of the…

I've been here several times and really like it. It's beautifully prepared and delicious. They have a vegan menu, too. I love the risotto and those pumpkin sandwiches. They haven't had it today, but I love the tiramisu. Everything is delicious too. The only downside is that it's always very crowded: if you come on the weekend, you'll have to wait. As is the case everywhere these days, there are a lot of foreigners…

3148.aj: 兵庫県豊岡市 城崎温泉

3149.aj: 〒357-0001 埼玉県飯能市宮沢２７−４９ 宮沢湖温泉 喜楽里別邸
3149.ed: Reviewers consistently praise this onsen for its reasonable prices, delicious food, and quiet, relaxing atmosphere. Guests particularly enjoy the open-air baths that offer stunning lake views. Some reviews mention the baths can be small and crowded.
3149.edj: クチコミによると、この温泉は手頃な価格、美味しい食事、そして静かで落ち着いた雰囲気が常に高く評価されています。特に、素晴らしい湖の景色を望む露天風呂は、利用した人々に好評です。 一部のクチコミでは、お風呂が小さく混雑することがあるという意見もあります。

rv.t: such a wonderful place for relaxing in nature! I love how this onsen facility is tucked away in the woods. The baths are well-maintained. Their staff regularly enters the onsen with a cylinder tube to check the hot spring water. Their restaurant is also excellent with reasonable prices and the perfect sunset view! This is, without a doubt, one of my favorite go-to-onsen ♥️

Convenient onsen right beside Metsa. Very nice to visit and refresh after walking all day in the adjacent shopping center and Moominvalley. Also provided a lovely view of Moominvalley at night. Food was very filling and delicious. The baths and sauna were a bit lackluster, but still did the job well.

If you would like to have the whole Japanese bath experience at a very reasonable price I would recommend this place. The location is great, the food is tasty and with a good number of outdoor and inside bath options including great the thermal-stone bathing options, all for a very, very reasonable price. I spent 3 hours there and left fully relaxed! Well recommended.

3150.a: Usagi∞, 3 Chome-17-21 Minamigyotoku, Ichikawa, Chiba 272-0138, Japan
3150.aj: 〒272-0138 千葉県市川市南行徳３丁目１７−２１ kitchenラビット

rv.t: 南行徳で前から行きたかったお店です！ 小鉢のボリュームが予想以上にありました！ 銀だら西京焼きと金華サーモンカマ焼きが美味しかったです！ 金華サーモンカマは脂の乗りが非常に良かったです！ 新潟産の米や味噌汁も野菜盛り沢山で美味しかったです！ 接客も丁寧で良かったです！ ごちそうさまでした！

以前から気になっていた家庭料理のお店に行ってきました！ 南行徳駅から徒歩5分程度。住宅街にある民家でやっているお店です。 お昼はkitchenラビット、夜はうさぎや（予約必須）でやっているみたいですね！お店に入ったら靴脱いで入ります。カウンターが6-7席と奥にテーブル席もありました。 支払いはキャッシュのみです。お弁当のテイクアウトも注文できるようです。 今回はランチの魚セットメニューを注文。 まず、一番楽しみにしていた前菜小鉢！お盆いっぱいに小鉢で7種類も！無農薬野菜を使って一つ一つおかみさんの手作り。しかも、鮮やかで見て嬉しい食べて美味しい。30品目以上あるようなので毎回種類もあるようなので他の日に行くのが楽しみになります。 メインの魚は花鯛の姿焼きと銀鱈西京焼き、金目鯛の兜煮付けと金華鯖焼き…

住宅街にひっそり佇む民家を改装したお店、入口も普通の民家なんでちょっと戸惑う。中はカウンターとテーブル席でカウンターは結構狭い。メインを選んでオーダーすると、小鉢のセットが出てくるんだけど、これがうまい！野菜がメインのお惣菜で味付けは薄味で野菜の味を楽しめます、適切な火入れをしているので歯応えがとても良く食べていて嬉しくなります。メインは銀鱈の煮付けと鰤かまの塩焼きを頼みました。銀鱈はトロトロで鰤かまは身がぎっしりで美味しかったです。お味噌汁も野菜たっぷりで食べ応えがありました。ちょっと贅沢なランチになってしまいましたが、とても満足しております。

3150.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3151.a: Japan, 〒401-0332 Yamanashi, Minamitsuru District, Fujikawaguchiko, Saiko, Saiko Iyashi-no-Sato Nemba (Traditional Japanese Village), 根場 ２７１０
3151.aj: 〒401-0332 山梨県南都留郡富士河口湖町西湖西湖いやしの里 根場 根場 ２７１０
3151.ed: Reconstructed Japanese village where visitors can explore houses & rent traditional clothing.
3151.edj: 日本の原風景を保存した集落。観光客は茅葺き屋根の古民家を巡ったり、着物の着付けを体験したりできる。

rv.t: This is a beautiful village, one of my favorite parts of my trip to Japan. Tsuchiasobi Fuji Roman-gama: this is a pottery workshop in the village & I highly recommend checking it out. The crafts are beautiful, and I went away with two handmade magnets & a fūrin. Restaurant Satoyama: delicious food made with local ingredients. My group explored the village on a cold and rainy day, the meal provided by the women in…

I recently visited this beautiful traditional village, famous for its historic thatched-roof houses and peaceful countryside atmosphere. Walking through the village felt like stepping back in time, surrounded by well-preserved architecture and stunning natural scenery. Unfortunately, the weather was cloudy on the day of my visit, so I wasn't able to see Mount Fuji, which is one of the highlights of this area. It was…

A reconstructed village that earns its reputation - not because of what it is, but because of what it sits in front of. Saiko Iyashi-no-Sato Nemba was flattened by a typhoon in the 1960s and rebuilt decades later as a working museum of traditional rural life. The thatched farmhouses, the streams running between them, the narrow paths - all of it is genuinely well done. But the real reason everyone is here is the…

3152.a: Kayabuki No Sato, Miyamachokita, Nantan, Kyoto 601-0712, Japan
3152.aj: 〒601-0712 京都府南丹市美山町北美山かやぶきの里
3152.ed: Historic hamlet surrounded by mountains, known for its houses with traditional thatched roofs.
3152.edj: 歴史情緒あふれる山間の集落。昔ながらの茅葺き屋根の家屋が残っていることで有名。

rv.t: A beautifully preserved historic village hidden in the mountains about 50 kilometers north of Kyoto City. While the oldest standing farmhouse in the area (the Ishida House) dates back over 350 years, the village as a whole feels entirely frozen in time, capturing the essence of old rural Japan. What Makes It Special The Thatch Architecture: "Kayabuki" means thatched roof. The village contains 50 houses, and 39 of…

Title: A peaceful and harmonious escape Visiting this village felt like stepping back in time. The traditional thatched-roof houses are in perfect harmony with the surrounding mountains and forests. It is incredibly peaceful and harmonious, offering a quiet beauty that you can't find in the big cities. A perfect place to relax and enjoy the scenery.
A beautiful step back in time. The village has about 30 traditional thatched-roof houses still used as homes. It’s peaceful, quiet, and perfect for photos. Feels like old Japan.

3153.a: Japan, 〒601-0743 Kyoto, Nantan, Miyamacho Miyawaki, Shinoda−36番地 美山のことむすび
3153.aj: 〒601-0743 京都府南丹市美山町宮脇篠田36番地 美山のことむすび

rv.t: 小腹が空いたので立ち寄りました。 店員さんやご主人さんも愛想の良い方で良かったです(^^) おにぎりは小腹を満たすには3つで丁度良く、がっつり食べたい方は唐揚げなんかもありました。飲み物は表の自動販売機にて各種ありました。美山にツーリングする際にまた立ち寄りたいです。
宮津に旅行に行って帰りに偶然見つけて寄ったどころです。川と木々が凄くて、まるで北ヨロッパの森みたいに感じました。本当に綺麗な森でしたね。お店は閉まっていたので、次回にまた行きましたらぜひ食事もしてみたいですね。
美山産のお米とお水で炊いたご飯。 約15種類から選べる具材。 由良川の流れと山の緑と美味しい空気。 明るい店主さん。 それが一つになった美味しい おにぎり🍙です。

3154.a: Japan, 〒150-0022 Tokyo, Shibuya, Ebisuminami, 1 Chome−20−3 パインハイツ 4F Caf'e MID STAMP ebisu
3154.aj: 〒150-0022 東京都渋谷区恵比寿南１丁目２０−３ パインハイツ 4F Caf'e MID STAMP ebisu
3154.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious food and drinks, including unique black lemonades and lattes, as well as tasty desserts like tiramisu and cheesecake. They also highlight the cozy, stylish atmosphere with plants and jazz music, making it a great spot for conversations or quiet work. Guests mention the staff provides attentive service, and the prices are reasonable for the area.
3154.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ユニークなブラックレモネードやラテを含むドリンク、ティラミスやチーズケーキなどのデザートが美味しいと評判です。また、植物やジャズ音楽が流れる居心地の良いおしゃれな雰囲気も特徴で、会話を楽しんだり、静かに作業したりするのに最適な場所とされています。スタッフの丁寧なサービスや、このエリアにしては手頃な価格も高く評価されています。

rv.t: Amazing café with a grungy / hipster vibe that is tucked on the 4th floor of a building that’s easily overlooked (and kept us wondering if we were really in the right place) if not for the signs. Once you‘ve stepped inside it‘s like you‘re in a little bubble outside the Tokyo hustle and bustle with amazing views of Ebisu and it is a cosy place to hang out with friends. The drinks are more special than the usual…
Very chill and hip place. The coffee is good, and pricing what you’d expect from a hipster cofffee shop. Nice little spot if you need to kill time before a dinner reservation
Low key cafe located on the 4st floors, It’s a bit hard to find but once your there, the atmosphere is amazing, WiFi is fast and the mood is super cozy.

コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: I'm always a bit suspicious about having a matcha at a coffe specialist cafe. What a great surprise. The Matcha was delicious. Place is confortable, minimalist and Jamiroquai was the soundtrack. What else!

Wanted to order a quick coffee to have in. I was with my partner who didn’t want caffeine so it would just have been me ordering for myself. The cafe was practically empty… and at first I thought the staff was saying you need to pick a seat before you order, but then I understood slowly that the staff was saying it’s one drink per person so if your partner is sitting he needs to buy a drink. So I was like… water?…
The new location for Swell. Good food, whilst the atmosphere is clean and new, but perhaps a little lacking.

3156.a: Trois, 3 Chome-10-5 Kotobuki, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0042, Japan
3156.aj: 〒111-0042 東京都台東区寿３丁目１０−５ トロワ

They also highlight the calm, quiet, and clean atmosphere, making it a comfortable spot for solo visits or small groups. Guests mention the staff are genuinely warm, attentive, and provide excellent service, creating a…
3156.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、濃厚でしっかりとしたプリンや季節のティラミスなど、美味しくて見た目も美しいデザートが高く評価されています。また、豊富な種類のコーヒーや紅茶も好評です。店内は落ち着いた静かで清潔な雰囲気で、一人でも少人数でも快適に過ごせる場所だとされています。スタッフは心から温かく、きめ細やかな気配りがあり、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているという声が多く、居心地の良い体験ができるようです。

rv.t: So lucky to walk-in and got sit in an instant. The strawberry tiramisu is fantastic paired with an iced americano. They accept cash only and have no English menu. The staff are very nice and welcoming! After I finished, there was already a lineup outside!
Perfect place for dessert lovers, so good we had to come back the next day to try more! The owners are so lovely and welcoming. Visiting here has made our trip to Tokyo :)

Truly a hidden gem of a café. The cakes show real craftsmanship and were absolutely delicious. The staff’s attentiveness made the experience even more pleasant, and the cozy atmosphere made it a perfect place to relax.

3157.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、風味豊かな唐揚げや濃厚な四角いチーズケーキなど、美味しくて健康的でバランスの取れた食事が提供されていると評判です。また、おしゃれで落ち着いた雰囲気も高く評価されており、ゆったりとランチやディナーを楽しむのに最適な場所とされています。 一方で、料理の値段が割高に感じられるという意見もあります。

rv.t: We went to a restaurant with a nice ambiance, but the food was disappointing. We ordered curry, dumplings, three vegetable appetizers, yuzu soda, and beer. When we got home, we both got food poisoning and our stomachs were terribly upset. If you're looking for delicious and affordable Japanese food, definitely avoid this place.

We came in on a Sunday 10 mins before their lunch last order time. However, they asked us if we would like to wait as there are groups of people waiting to be seated. We confirmed and they had us scan a qr code to be queued for lunch. Our number got called 30mins later. There are some exhibitions going on in the same building and 30mins is easily spent there so you can walk around for the mean time. We had the curry…

Delicious and chic! This restaurant is in an art building and has entry through the river side. It has more of a shared bites sort of vibe, which is right up my alley. We got the fried chicken, the gyoza, the chicken curry, and the sorbet. All of it was so good, and the service was also kind and accommodating. The people next to us were celebrating an anniversary, and they got a personalized message with their…

3158.aj: 〒107-0052 東京都港区赤坂７丁目２−２１ 2階 Connel Coffee
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
3158.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, hearty sandwiches, and baked goods, with many highlighting the strong, stable Wi-Fi and charging ports. They also appreciate the calm, cozy atmosphere, often with views of greenery, making it ideal for work or relaxation. Some reviews mention the service can be impolite.
3158.edj: このカフェを利用した人のクチコミでは、おいしいコーヒーやボリュームのあるサンドイッチ、焼き菓子が提供されており、特に強力で安定したWi-Fiと充電ポートが評価されています。また、落ち着いた居心地の良い雰囲気で、緑豊かな景色を眺めながら仕事やリラックスができる点も好評です。 一方で、店員の対応が丁寧ではないという声も一部見受けられます。

rv.t: Great ambience and a perfect spot to people-watch or enjoy some greenery. Their free WiFi is strong and stable, so I was able to work comfortably. I also spotted charging ports near the counter, which is ideal for remote workers. Tried the Salted Caramel Latte and it was really good. Overall, cozy vibe + great coffee. Recommended!

One of the most beautiful coffee spots I’ve seen in Tokyo. The atmosphere is magical, with a stunning view of either a park or a peaceful stone garden. The coffee is absolutely delicious, the desserts are lovely, and the staff is super friendly. I also really appreciated that the water is finally served in glass bottles – such a nice touch. I truly recommend this place. For me, it’s definitely a top café in Tokyo.

Stopped at this place to have a quick coffee and work on my Laptop! (Laptop friendly place) Limited seats but rather a very cozy place, with low jazzy music for the atmosphere! The views towards the park are also very lovely!

3159.edj: クチコミによると、このカフェでは、豊かな香りと深い味わいの美味しいコーヒーが楽しめると評判です。カレープレートやしっとりとしたパウンドケーキなど、健康的でありながら満足感のある食事も提供されています。また、店内はスタイリッシュで広々としており、ユニークなブロック状の座席や街の景色が見えるテラス席があり、リラックスできる雰囲気も特徴です。 一方で、サービスが非効率的だと感じる人もいるようです。

rv.t: Very spacious. It’s quite relaxing. It’s a good spot to take a rest while shopping and wandering in Omotesando / Harajuku area:) coffee also tastes good enough to enjoy, food is also not too bad 👍

Nice café with a great view of the city. The interior is relaxed and the coffee and snacks are great. A little pricey but it’s worth the coffee and fairly quiet atmosphere of the place. Make sure to reserve a table before ordering since seating is limited. The only downside is that the waiting time sometimes takes very long. I went here most recently on a day right after the holidays and waited around 15 minutes to…
Different types of coffee selection. Milk brew at the time of posting had nice fruity flavours. English menu.

3160.edj: 本棚と木製家具をあしらい、こぢんまりとした居心地の良いカフェ。軽食とドリンクを提供する。

rv.t: Loved the bacon french toast; the bread was soft and didn’t taste overly eggy, while the bacon was thick and not greasy. Would taste even better with some maple syrup though. The soy matcha latte was also great; concentrated, minimal bitterness, seaweed-y notes, and generously filled to the brim. The cafe had a nice cozy atmosphere, and the staff were lovely and attentive.

We went to this place on Sunday morning and it was full, so we went again on Monday morning. The place was very cozy and nice, coffee and croissants were amazing. The staffs are very friendly and polite, and they are very handsome 😂😂😂
The green smoothie at yellow Café , and ESPECIALLY the coffee was remarkable 🤩🤩🤩 coffee quality is 10/10 Food options are limited, but tasty. I would come back again!

3161.a: Japan, 〒160-0013 Tokyo, Shinjuku City, Kasumigaokamachi, 5−7 都立明治公園 D棟 BLUE SIX COFFEE
3161.aj: 〒160-0013 東京都新宿区霞ヶ丘町５−７ 都立明治公園 D棟 BLUE SIX COFFEE
3161.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious food, including avocado toast, tuna melt sandwiches, and gluten-free rice flour desserts, along with high-quality coffee. They also highlight the cozy and relaxing atmosphere, with ample natural light and views of the park, making it suitable for working or unwinding. Guests mention the friendly and attentive staff, and appreciate practical amenities like…
3161.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、おいしいコーヒーと、ボリュームのあるアボカドトーストや風味豊かなフレンチトーストなど、幅広い種類の食事が提供されていると評判です。また、美しい公園の景色、落ち着いた雰囲気、親切で気の利くスタッフも高く評価されています。無料Wi-Fiや電源コンセント、エレベーターといった便利な設備も好評で、ペット同伴の人を含め、誰もが利用しやすいカフェとされています。

rv.t: I was in the area and wanted a coffee so stopped by this place. The system was a little weird but you get a number and then they call you for you to order. You can scan the QR code to let you know the time. I ordered the coffee and carrot cake. The coffee was good, and the taste of the carrot cake was decent, but just a bit dry. The icing was thick and creamy though. The upstairs seating was comfortable and had a…

THE TUNA MELT WAS 10/10 AMAZING!! I’ve never had green onions in a tuna melt, and now I can’t imagine one without it. I also got an iced latte, but for the price, I was disappointed in the espresso-milk ratio; it was super milky :( The espresso was DELICIOUS and rich, but there was too much milk to properly enjoy it, and the fact that it was ~¥700 for the drink alone didn’t really help. I would definitely go again…

a comforting cafe with a nice view of the park. it was suitable both for hangouts or working/studying. the wifi was great and there were a lot of plugs! i bought the date latte, it wasn't bad but would try other drink next time (the size is nice tho). also the walnut brownie is really good!

3162.a: Kosoen Studio, 8 Chome-200 Nagabuchi, Ome, Tokyo 198-0052, Japan
3162.aj: 〒198-0052 東京都青梅市長淵８丁目２００ 藍染工房 壺草苑（染色工房／直売／体験工房）

rv.t: Had a great time with the indigo dyeing experience. Staff was friendly and instructive, and gave ideas as to how we could accomplish our desired results. Studio was super clean, well ventilated and really well maintained. Thanks you for the Kosoen Studio team for a great afternoon!

I was welcomed with great warmth and enthusiasm,was permitted to take a few photos ,had a nice chat and a good tour of the workshop.I'm very happy I took the detour to visit,bought two scarf and some coasters.Was also recommended a good restaurant where I ate the best meal I had in Japan if not in my entire life.Thank you for an amazing experience and wonderful day .Will come back on my next trip to Japan.

The master 'sensei' was very knowledgeable about indigo from different parts of Asia. The place is more than 100 years old and they teach you how to dye clothes using indigo. Must visit if you are keen on learning the process of dying (blue)!

3163.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious pho, noting its rich, flavorful broth and tender beef, with options for extra cilantro or none. They also highlight the variety of table condiments, including chili sauce and garlic vinegar, for customizing flavors. Guests mention the clean interior, fast service, and reasonable prices, making it a convenient spot for a quick, satisfying meal.
3163.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、牛肉のフォーが高く評価されています。濃厚で風味豊かなスープとやわらかな牛肉が特徴で、パクチーの追加や抜きも選べるとのことです。また、チリソースやニンニク酢など、味を調整できる卓上調味料が豊富に用意されている点も好評です。店内は清潔感があり、提供が早く、価格も手頃なため、手軽に満足感のある食事をしたいときに便利な場所として利用されています。

rv.t: This is a branch of a well-known pho restaurant chain from Vietnam. I usually eat at the Ikebukuro branch, and this was my first time trying the one in Shinjuku. But the food quality isn’t very consistent between locations tbh. I found the broth here a bit bland and not as rich in flavor. The restaurant itself is clean and spacious though. If you’re expecting an authentic Vietnamese pho experience, I don’t think…

visited Pho Thin Tokyo's Shinjuku branch and ordered their famous signature beef pho. It tasted absolutely delicious! The broth had a wonderful depth of flavor, packed with fresh green onions and tender beef. The service was quick and the vibes were great. A must-visit if you are in the Shinjuku area!

This is one of the best Pho restaurants in Japan that I've tried so far, as it keeps the flavor close to the original in Vietnam. I eat here at least 3–4 times a month. Recently, it's been a bit disappointing because I've seen flies twice while dining. Hygiene needs to be improved.

3164.ed: Diners like this restaurant's unique sea bream ramen, which features a rich, flavorful broth and firm, chewy noodles, along with delicious side dishes like grilled onigiri. They also highlight the tranquil, stylish atmosphere, professional service, and good value for the quality of food. Some reviews mention the ramen can be expensive.
3164.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、濃厚で風味豊かなスープと、しっかりとした歯ごたえのある麺が特徴の真鯛ラーメン、そして焼きおにぎりのような美味しいサイドメニューを高く評価しています。また、落ち着いたおしゃれな雰囲気、プロフェッショナルなサービス、そして料理の質に見合った良い価格設定も特徴です。 クチコミの中には、ラーメンが高価だと感じる人もいるようです。

rv.t: this interesting restaurant specializes in all things sea bream! I ordered their lunch set combo, which seems to be the popular choice. You pick between onigiri or gelato and pasta or ramen. I tried some of the sea bream dashi grilled onigiri. It is sooooo good. The eggplant salad wasn't bad. Especially considering i dont like eggplant. The fried sea bream wasnt bad either! not super heavy or oily which is the…

As a sea bream lover, I found this ramen shop in Ebisu through Tabelog, and it turned out to be a great pick. I ordered the set, which comes with three small appetizers — and I have to say, the scallop baguette was incredibly good. The ramen noodles felt more like Italian pasta in texture: firm, springy, and perfectly cooked. Exactly the kind of bite I enjoy. A very satisfying meal overall.

It’s seriously a must-go!!! I walked in alone about an hour before they close for a last minute dinner. That was one of the best decisions I made this trip because this had to be one of, if not the single most delicious and unique bowls of ramen I’ve ever tried. I got the sea bream ramen and added some olives. I also ordered a muscat soda which was refreshing and well balanced with the salty umami broth. I will…

3165.aj: 〒100-0004 東京都千代田区大手町１丁目６−１ 大手町ビルヂング B2 らぁ麺 貝と煮干し、時々濃厚
3165.ed: Diners like this ramen shop's flavorful clam and dried sardine broths, as well as the tender char siu and firm noodles. They also highlight the clean, bright atmosphere, efficient service, and convenient cashless payment options. Other reviews mention the ramen can be overpriced.
3165.edj: このラーメン店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、風味豊かなアサリや煮干しの出汁が効いたスープ、柔らかいチャーシュー、そしてコシのある麺が高く評価されています。また、清潔感のある明るい店内、効率的なサービス、便利なキャッシュレス決済も好評のようです。 一方で、ラーメンの価格が割高に感じられるという意見もあります。

rv.a: Onsen with Hansen 【温泉が大好きなハンセン】
rv.t: 【ちょっと贅沢なラーメン体験】 Visiting “KaitoNibosi, TokidokiNoukou” was a delightful experience, blending premium ambiance with delicious, health-conscious ramen. I opted for the signature Clam and Shijimi Ramen (蛤としじみのらぁ麺) with an additional Ajitama. The price was slightly higher than average at 1,460 yen, but the quality justified it. The ramen had a wonderfully delicate flavor, with a broth based on clams and shells that felt…
For a fast ramen, can't ask for anything more. Delicious, fair price, fast, great service.
Refreshing ramen with yuzu bits. Not open on weekends or public holidays

3166.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious, hearty sandwiches and coffee, with spotless and spacious restrooms. They also highlight the relaxing rooftop terrace, friendly staff, and welcoming atmosphere. Other reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
3166.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ボリュームたっぷりの美味しいサンドイッチやコーヒーが高く評価されています。清潔で広々としたトイレも好評です。また、リラックスできるルーフトップテラス、親しみやすいスタッフ、そして居心地の良い雰囲気が特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、サービスが非効率的だと感じるという意見もあります。

rv.t: A hidden rooftop café with a relaxed atmosphere and a great spot for a leisurely breakfast. The fried chicken sandwich was crispy and flavorful, topped with a perfectly runny egg that made every bite rich and satisfying. The coffee was smooth and well-balanced, pairing nicely with the food. The outdoor seating area is cozy and photogenic, with plenty of natural light and a laid-back vibe that makes it easy to…

My boyfriend says this is the best sandwich he has EVER had. Lovely rooftop bar and restaurant. Small place with only one chef so expect to wait for a table/food. It is also compulsory to buy one drink per person but they have lists of great options!

A couple of food choices (mainly sandwiches), and all are a good pick for breakfast/brunch. Iced mocha was extremely good. For two people: 2 sandwiches, fries with mac&cheese on top, and 2 coffees was ¥5,300. A little pricier than most things but not too bad. Would highly recommend.

The space feels warm and stylish in a way that makes you want to linger a little longer. I got the avocado toast and loved the artisan bread they used. It tasted like a sourdough or rye base — whatever it was, it had the same texture as the sourdough batard I’m used to…

Really nice bakery, super friendly staff and a nice menu. The vanilla cashew butter toast was really good and they have a small range of local beers as well as usual coffees and soft drinks (and a decent selection of wines). Really nice decor and a relaxed vibe.... Also had the potato salad and hummus dishes, would recommend.

We came to a special opening at evening time which was such a pleasant surprise! Food was delicious! The pear lemongrass sour was very tasty and so easy to drink. The service from everyone was excellent, they were so welcoming and warm and we talked about our hometowns. The decor is really cool. The music playlist was such a vibe. Love.

Cafe vibes on point here. Lots of space to chill or work. Staff is super helpful and friendly despite not speaking Japanese. The drinks were fantastic. Basque cheesecake is delicious. Worth a stop!!

Amber Café is an absolute gem! The cozy and aesthetic ambiance makes it the perfect spot to relax or catch up with friends. The drinks are delicious —and the pastries are fresh and delightful. The staff is super friendly and attentive, making every visit enjoyable. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a calm, stylish café experience!✨

rv.t: Fresh brewed coffee, have various types of desserts option as well. The place itself is big, as they produce their own coffee beans, but they have a limited amount of seats. Had to wait a bit to get a seat inside.

The cafe is absolutely beautiful! We came first thing on a Sunday morning and by the time the shop opened there was a line waiting to be seated- so get there early! The chocolate cake was more like a shortcake in that it wasn’t very rich or dense/ didn’t have much depth of flavour. My friend who drank their normal coffee said it was average, and my Darjeeling tea was normal too. For the price, you are definitely…

Had their Panama Geisha and it was really great. Such a delicate and well balanced flavor. I will definitely be back to try some pf their other single origin coffees and perhaps even some of their proprietary blends. The place is a full scale roastery so i really loved the ambience. The only downside was that there is no wifi, otherwise i would drink coffee here all day. :)

rv.t: One of the better cafes I’ve been to in Tokyo. Directly across the street from the north side of Zempukuji park (north of the upper pond). Very large indoor and outdoor space with a ton of seating. The space is an open concept with a double height ceiling that’s inspiring to just sit and have a coffee, read a book, or do some work. The space is really what sets this cafe apart - it’s so cool. The food is great and…

Lovely cafe with food options. The staffs are friendly and the place is spacious with available parking. They also sell super cute treats for dogs. It’s also next to a park. I’m so glad I found this place

If you’re looking for a place where to relax and read some novels or whatever, the nido-cafe would be the one of perfect cafe in tokyo. They have the best coffee available and even some fresh baked goods as well. The ambiance of this shop was so relaxing, and the staffs are highly capable. I could not ask for more because everything that I needed was provided. Well done, guys! Keep making great coffee and pastries!…

3171.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious grilled local chicken and salt-grilled ayu, which are delivered via a unique boat system. They also highlight the traditional atmosphere and the option to rent fishing rods. Other reviews mention there can be early closures.
3171.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、地元の美味しい地鶏の炭火焼きや鮎の塩焼きを高く評価しています。料理はユニークな船のシステムで運ばれてくるのが特徴です。昔ながらの雰囲気も魅力で、釣り竿をレンタルして楽しむこともできるというクチコミもあります。 一方で、早めに受付が終了してしまうことがあるという情報もあります。

rv.t: Greate restaurant! You can enjoy wild animal meat here, like deer and bore!!!! The raw chicken and deer meat is really good. If you get the raw deer meat and it comes out frozen, give it some time to thaw out.

ＧＷに訪問、非常に人気店でありハイシーズンである為、8時45分に到着もロープが張られてあり中に入れなかった。9時過ぎには入れる様になっていた。すでに車が5台あり。9時半には16台、10時には30台になり行列でした。予約や名前など書く紙はなく、並び順。10時20分頃お部屋に案内され、注文は後から定員さんが聞きにくるスタイル。11時頃水路から料理が流れて来ました。10時過ぎに来られた方はご案内されたかわかりません。定員を超えると本日の受付が終了とのこと。料理は非常に美味しく鮎も地鶏もきっと満足します。釣竿のレンタルもあります。

11月末に行きました。開店1時間前くらいに着きましたが、すでに行列でした。開店前に並ばないと入れないと思います。圏外だったのでおしゃべりして暇を潰してました。寒かったこともあり、自販機の温かい飲み物は売り切れていました。 開店してから、店の隣の建物へ案内されました。ストーブなどはついておらず、極寒の中まず注文まで20分ほど待ちました。寒すぎたため、地鶏を頼んで七輪で暖を取ることにしました。地鶏はすぐ運ばれましたが、鮎は注文してから1時間ほどで運ばれました。 私たちの隣の席の方が、注文まで時間がかかると聞いて車内で待機していたためか、店員さんが予定していたより少し早く注文を取りに来たこともあり、座席に居なかったため順番を飛ばされ、戻ってきた頃には鮎が売り切れてしまっていたようでした。皆様も注意してください。 あと、自分が何番か絶対に忘れないようにしてください！！！船が流れちゃいます！…

Worth a visit if you're nearby and into pretty…

The staff were lovely and very patient with my terrible Japanese. The café has a really nice atmosphere, and the coffee was excellent. They also offer oat milk, which was a nice bonus. 10/10, raw sugar roast is the perfect coffee spot. The coffee was amazing, very good quality with lovely flavours. The cinnamon roll was also delicious. The staff were very lovely and kind. Inside is beautiful with a relaxed atmosphere. Thank you for having us, Sophie & Jack from Australia

Friendly staff and everything is cooked freshly. There a pond inside the restaurant where they keep fresh fish to cook and an open pit where they cook and prepared the fish in an traditional way. Great seasonal and mountain veggies (pretty sure everything…

I think they stop serving at 4pm so be careful to get there early. My eyes hurt a bit from the smoke as they are smoking the fish and mochi in a pit in the middle but it was nice to be so close to see what they are doing. Definitely recommend trying the Mochi and Amazake! We…

Prepare to wait a bit , slow down and enjoy the atmosphere of this traditional restaurant. Owner is super friendly and gives you a homely feeling.He gave us some chilly from his garden to take home.
